items.title: Eddie Johnson Interview, 1962-11-06
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Buster Moore lives up around here somewhere, too, doesn't he? You know him? Who is that? Buster Moore, trombone player? [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, yes, yes, yes.

ctx.x: Pretty nice, I heard him. He still walked with him. You haven't? He's sick. I haven't seen him in quite a while. That's what I heard in the news for them.

I haven't seen him in quite a while. I just, you know, I try to get him out of the scene, but... So many people have been sick lately. And Buster Moore lives up around here somewhere, too, doesn't he? You know him? Who is that? Buster Moore, trombone player?
